_source: Static UI keys for the mobile technician close-out screen (route tech-close, pototype/mobile-screens.jsx MTechClose L263-311). KEYS ONLY — never a translation. MIXED LAYERS: fields listed as dict below are stable ids read with t(); the rest are the Thai phrase that IS the phrases-layer key, read with tp(). This is a THIN-HONEST port (the B-229 / B-246 'ข' precedent): service_ticket has NO signature column, NO before/after photo column, NO work-detail column, NO materials column, and the close op explicitly IGNORES a client `{rating}` because there is no rating column either (apps/api/src/routes/sales-service.ts L354-359). Every one of the five content labels below is therefore kept as CHROME over an honest em-dash — the pm-notes parts-slot precedent — and BLOCKERS.md B-294 files the whole set. ZERO-MINT for every action word: btnFix=sales.service.statusFixed 'ซ่อมเสร็จ' (the `fix` move; this is also the label the merged WEB after-sales port uses for that op), btnClose=sales.service.statusClosed 'ปิดงาน' (the `close` move), btnClosedDone=sales.service.btnClosedDone 'ปิดงานแล้ว' (the terminal honest-DISABLED state, the same key the web port uses for it), saved=labor.att.savedBadge, failed=admin.common.actionFailedToast (the pm_checkin / pm_checklist / pm_notes precedent, BLOCKERS.md B-268 ก). SIX values are net-new and staged in agents/orch-d-recon/service-group-i18n.apply.json for a Wei sacred round (docs/extract/i18n-full.json is UNTOUCHED by this slice): title 'ปิดงานซ่อม' (L266 — the same phrase tech_jobs' card button uses to open this screen, minted once and shared), fieldBefore 'ก่อนซ่อม' (L270), fieldAfter 'หลังซ่อม' (L276), fieldWorkDetails 'รายละเอียดงานที่ทำ' (L282), fieldMaterials 'วัสดุที่ใช้' (L285), signatureTitle 'ลายเซ็นรับงานจากลูกค้า' (L292). Each was grepped out of the raw .jsx this round and is asserted byte-exact by test/screens/service/service_sidecar_test.dart; all six already resolve in Thai today (tp returns the key for lang th) and light up en/zh/ar once applied. See BLOCKERS.md B-292. NOT REPRESENTED HERE — three prototype strings are DROPPED rather than keyed, because each is a PROMISE and a promise cannot be em-dashed the way a missing value can: (1) the CTA label 'ปิดงาน + ส่งแบบประเมิน' (L305) promises a satisfaction survey on top of the close — the close happens, the survey does not exist anywhere (no rating column, no survey endpoint, and the handler throws the client's rating away), so the button is labelled with the destination status alone. The merged WEB port still renders the fuller sales.service.btnCloseEval for the same op, so B-294 asks Wei to reconcile the two; if fidelity wins, that key is already in the dict and this slot points at it with no mint. (2) 'เซ็นที่นี่' (L297) — the hint inside the signature pad; there is no pad, because there is no signature column and a mark nobody stores must not be captured (adding a signature-pad or camera package is a Wei-level stack decision, the geolocator / B-260 precedent). (3) the mock signer line 'คุณภัทร์รดา ดวงดี · 27 พ.ค. 2569 · 15:42' (L299) is mock DATA over a column that does not exist. The bar's 44px edit button (L303) carries no text and is dropped with them: with every field an em-dash there is nothing on this screen to edit.
_layers: dict (t): btnFix · btnClose · btnClosedDone · saved · failed. phrases (tp): title · fieldBefore · fieldAfter · fieldWorkDetails · fieldMaterials · signatureTitle.
